partner_result_applied.application: Extended the exact cube-fiber identity from alpha=2/3 to every positive conditional-height moment.

mathematical_change.statement: For 0<alpha<2 the exact moment equals [m^(-alpha/2)Gamma(m+1)Gamma(2-alpha)/Gamma(m+1-alpha)]^2 and grows as Gamma(2-alpha)^2 m^alpha; for alpha>=2 it is infinite at fixed m.
mathematical_change.interpretation: No positive conditional projection-height moment can universally pay the nonlinear quadratic trace.
